environment: Fictional local Vite preview; headless Chromium 1237 using SwiftShader. Browser plugin unavailable.
method: Independent design assessment A and technical/detector assessment B, plus primary interaction testing. A completed before B findings were delivered.

findings.title: Expanded mobile sky loses usable framing
findings.observations: At 390x844, eight of twelve sign labels remained visible after expansion; Reset restored all twelve. At 844x390, expanded canvas height was 124.8125 CSS pixels and sign labels overlapped.
findings.recommendation: Adapt bookmarked framing to available aspect ratio and give the scene usable space in landscape by collapsing secondary controls.

findings.title: Placement text clipped at 320px
findings.observations: Sun cell ended at x112; Cancer text ended at x116.81 and was obscured by selected neighboring cell.
findings.recommendation: Stack icon and name or reflow placement strip at narrow widths.

findings.title: Selected sky readout not associated visually with actual marker
findings.observations: Selected Sun/Moon/Rising name is centered while the plotted marker stays at its longitude; native icons differ from scene marker shapes.
findings.recommendation: Connect readout to marker and use a matching visual key.

findings.title: Phone entry hides the explanation below scene controls
findings.observations: Initial viewport shows mode rows, scene, camera and atmosphere controls, then chapter rail; introductory explanation and primary first-chapter action are below the fold. Read chapter starts disabled, with all four scene chapter labels hidden.
findings.recommendation: Put a short invitation and first-chapter action before the mobile canvas; disclose secondary scene controls.

findings.title: Graphics failure leaves instructions for disabled controls
findings.observations: After forced WebGL context loss, operation hints still instruct turning the object/opening the desk; native reading and graphics retry still work.
findings.recommendation: Gate guidance by graphics availability and put a reading action beside retry.

verified.context_loss_retry: Independent B receipts verified: canvas 0 on loss, reader and selection retained, retry canvas 1 with live context and controls enabled
verified.idle_draw_observation: Independent B: 0 WebGL draw calls across 1.2 seconds at rest

detector: 105 advisories, 0 non-advisories. Many overridden CSS/document mismatches; do not interpret as 105 confirmed UX defects. Browser overlays succeeded on three states; no live visible user overlay.
minor_notes: Sky reading subsection skips h3 in standalone mode

No physical GPU/mobile-device or Safari/Firefox testing
